public.title: Cancellable Interval
public.description: Simulate a cancellable interval. Given start, positive period, cancelTime and horizon, return tick times. All are integers from 0 through 120, period is from 1 through 20, and cancelTime is null or an integer no earlier than start. The first tick is start plus period. A cancellation wins a tie with a tick, so no tick at cancelTime fires. A horizon tie includes the tick. No wall-clock timer is used. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
